_comment: Bolna agent config for Kural. Three custom_task tools call the live brain. Set up in Bolna Agent Studio (see docs/architecture/04-bolna-wiring.md). Verify exact field names against docs.bolna.ai before importing.

llm._note: any function-calling LLM works (Gemini / Groq / GPT)

tools.name: file_grievance
tools.description: Call AFTER the caller confirms. Files the civic grievance and returns a ticket number + owning body. For ELECTRICITY BILL disputes also pass units_used, amount_charged, and (if the caller knows it) expected_amount — the brain computes the over-charge.

sector.description: electricity, water_supply, sewerage, roads_internal, roads_highway, stormwater, streetlight, solid_waste, sanitation_toilet, public_health, stray_animals, town_planning, property_tax, other

locality.description: area / street / city the caller said (e.g., 'Kuniyamuthur 12th Street Coimbatore')

amount_charged.description: amount the bill charged (bill disputes only)

expected_amount.description: the caller's normal/expected bill, if they know it

tools.name: check_area_status
tools.description: Call when the caller asks whether an issue is already reported, or to check if their problem is common in the area. Returns how many people already reported the same issue+area.

tools.name: get_ticket_status
tools.description: Call when a returning caller gives their ticket number (e.g., KRL-2026-00042) and wants its status.
